overall_goal: Gather the sauce ingredients including sriracha, soy sauce, peanut butter, and coconut milk, and prepare them for use.

goals.description: Retrieve sriracha and soy sauce from the cupboard and place them on the counter.
goals.rationale: The person takes both the sriracha and soy sauce from the cupboard, checks the label, closes the door, and sets them on the counter.

goals.description: Retrieve peanut butter from the cupboard and a teaspoon from the drawer.
goals.rationale: The person gets the peanut butter out of the cupboard, places it on the counter, and then fetches a teaspoon from the cutlery drawer.

goals.description: Retrieve a tin of coconut milk from the cupboard and open it.
goals.rationale: The person closes the cupboard doors while holding the coconut milk, places it on the counter, and later opens the tin with a tin opener.
